residents.name: Abhishek
residents.notes: lactose intolerant (lactose-free / almond / soy milk only); dislikes bitter gourd and brinjal; dal-rice daily lunch staple, roti + curry default dinner; chicken on request (home-style chicken curry with roti); likes paneer paratha; fiancee is a dietician - interested in higher-protein healthy Indian dishes; seasons boldly

cook.name: Sona Didi
cook.schedule: Once daily ~7 PM, Mon-Sat; on WFH days she prepares dinner AND next day's lunch in the same visit
notes: Build curries from a slow-cooked masala base; season to a fuller, bolder profile (first dinner was under-seasoned).
Use the resident's own homemade garam masala (masala storage section in the kitchen).
Kitchen must not be used until a scheduled deep-clean is done when one is a prerequisite.

person_rules.note: Lactose intolerant - dairy-heavy dishes only if the dairy can be swapped (lactose-free/almond/soy milk); never regular dairy milk.

frequency_caps.name: Chicken
frequency_caps.note: Chicken is added on request, not a daily default; ordered right before cooking, never pre-stocked.

ingredient_grade_rules.rule: Cold-pressed only - no palm oil, no refined oil.
Resident's homemade garam masala only - never store-bought.
Lactose-free, almond or soy milk only.
Order the same day it is cooked; never stocked ahead.

breakfast_style: Breakfast routinely skipped at home - not planned.

cooking_technique.seasoning: Season with confidence - salt, masala and spice to taste, not mild
cooking_technique.curry_base: Cook the masala base longer before adding vegetables for depth
cooking_technique.masala: Homemade garam masala from the resident's stock

nutrition_direction: Lean toward higher-protein, dietician-style healthy Indian dishes (not yet a strict rule)
standing_instructions: WFH days: lunch + dinner prepped in one evening visit; office days: dinner only (breakfast/lunch provided at office).
Dal-rice is the daily lunch staple; roti + curry (sabzi varies) the default dinner; idli/dosa occasionally.
Chicken only on request, ordered the same day.
Kitchen not to be used before a scheduled deep-clean is completed; arrange cleaning and cooking together.
Daily WhatsApp check-in for meal-plan approval and skip/cancel.
non_negotiables: No palm oil, no refined oil - cold-pressed only.
No regular dairy milk - lactose-free/almond/soy only.
Kitchen not used before a scheduled clean is done.
notes: Exact weekly split of dinner-only vs dinner+lunch days never confirmed (asked Aug 25).
No fresh-vs-packaged rule beyond oil/masala - don't assume one.
